attempted_claim: Let G be a one-ended Gromov-hyperbolic group that admits a proper, cocompact action on a CAT(0) cube complex. Does G admit a proper, cocompact, hyperplane-essential action on a CAT(0) cube complex with a single G-orbit of hyperplanes? Equivalently, does there exist a one-ended hyperbolic cocompactly cubulated G for which no hyperplane-essential cubulation has a single orbit of hyperplanes?
decisive_failure: Single-orbit cubulation is fully settled at the essential level by Fioravanti-Hagen, but hyperplane-essentiality plus single orbit remains open; this report proves no direction of the target and offers no counterexample, only documented blocked routes and the exact published gap. No computation or new construction is claimed.
